questionText: The theme of uncertainty features in this story. Give two examples from the text. (Can be language use and/or content.)

rows.verbatim: Uncertainty: the answers the scheme accepts

options: Lena questions herself whether or not she knew Jo was in love with Marie. // She would hurt Jo’s feelings when she told him about Can’s interest in Marie.
She asks herself if she just wanted to see Jo’s reaction to her remarks.
She asks herself if she wanted Jo herself.
The reader is never told what nickname Jo gave the narrator.
The narrator is not sure whether she should sit beside Marie.
(Jo has disappeared) it is uncertain where he went / nobody knows where he is.
Lena does not know why she nods when everybody agrees with Marie’s decision.
Marie will look for Jo although she only has a vague idea / can only guess where he might be.
Lena is not certain why she offered her car. / She doesn’t know what is wrong with her.
She/Lena is uncertain/asks herself why she agreed to go on the trip.
At the end of the story the reader still does not know where exactly the group is going to look for Jo. / They are going South ‒ seemingly without a certain/definite destination.
‘Alle sind da. Alle ‒ bis auf Jo’ ‒ why is Jo not there?
‚Ich gehöre nicht mehr richtig dazu‘ ‒ showing Lena does not quite belong to the group.
She/Lena asks a lot of questions.
Use of ‘ich zögere’ ‒ showing that Lena is hesitating/not sure whether she should take Jo’s place beside Marie. (“Ich zögere” – on its own without explanation not enough)
Use of (Jo) ist verschwunden, einfach abgehauen ‒ showing Jo just left ‒ without announcing any plan/intention…
